id.description: Unique identifier that identifies each step in a job.

startTime.description: Step execution start time in UTC format.

endTime.description: Step execution end time in UTC format.

lastUpdated.description: Last updated time for a step in UTC format.

statusMessage.description: Displays the status of a step.

name.description: Name of different steps the job goes through.

timeElapsed.description: Time lapsed since the step execution started.
